# Agents

Create, read, list and update agents.

**Library:** [Maitento](index.md#maitento), for apps. More in [Agents](../../../concepts/agents.md).

| Call | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`AgentCreate`](#agentcreate) | Creates an agent: a model with standing instructions. |
| [`AgentGet`](#agentget) | Returns an agent's definition, with every version. |
| [`AgentList`](#agentlist) | Returns the agents in a namespace. |
| [`AgentUpdate`](#agentupdate) | Saves a new version of an agent, with a new name, model, instructions or summary, and returns the agent. |

### AgentCreate

Creates an agent: a model with standing instructions. Returns the new agent.

```c
jsonObject AgentCreate(string name, string aiModelId, string systemPrompt, string summary, string namespaceName)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The agent's name: letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.`, at most 128 characters, unique in its namespace. |
| `aiModelId` | `string` | The `id` of a model from the catalogue, as [`AiModelList`](models.md#aimodellist) returns it (not the model's name). |
| `systemPrompt` | `string` | The agent's standing instructions: who it is and how it behaves. |
| `summary` | `string` | One line that describes the agent to other agents, such as a router or a manager choosing who works next. |
| `namespaceName` | `string`, can be empty | The namespace to create it in. Pass `""` for this app's own namespace. |

**Returns** `jsonObject`: The new agent, as a JSON object: `id`, `name`, `namespaceId` and `versions`, each with `version`, `aiModelId`, `systemPrompt`, `summaryForOtherAgents`, `externalOperationReferences` (its tools) and `isDisabled`.

Its first version runs on the model you name, with the instructions and summary you give. It has no tools, routes to no other agents, can't start sub-interactions and has no web tools: for those, define the agent in your project and deploy it. An agent made here isn't in your project's files, and a deploy doesn't delete it.

Fails with `Invalid AI model ID format: …` when `aiModelId` isn't an id, and when the name is taken (`Agent '…' already exists in namespace '…'`) or not a valid name, the model isn't in the catalogue, or the namespace doesn't exist.

### AgentGet

Returns an agent's definition, with every version.

```c
jsonObject AgentGet(string name)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The agent: `name`, or `name@namespace`. |

**Returns** `jsonObject`: The agent, as a JSON object.

Name the agent as `name`, or `name@namespace` for one in another namespace of your tenant; a name without `@` is looked up in this app's namespace.

The JSON object holds `id`, `name`, `namespaceId`, `dateCreated`, `dateUpdated` and `versions`. Each version has `version`, `aiModelId` (the catalogue model it runs on), `systemPrompt`, `summaryForOtherAgents`, `externalOperationReferences` (its tools), `routedSubAgents`, `allowSwarm`, `allowWebSearch`, `allowWebFetch` and `isDisabled`.

Fails with `Not found` when there is no such agent, and `Namespace '…' was not found.` when the namespace doesn't exist.

### AgentList

Returns the agents in a namespace.

```c
jsonArray AgentList(string namespaceName)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `namespaceName` | `string`, can be empty | The namespace to list. Pass `""` for this app's own namespace. |

**Returns** `jsonArray`: A JSON array of agents.

Each element of the JSON array is an agent as [`AgentGet`](#agentget) returns it. Fails with `Namespace '…' was not found.` when the namespace doesn't exist.

### AgentUpdate

Saves a new version of an agent, with a new name, model, instructions or summary, and returns the agent.

```c
jsonObject AgentUpdate(string name, string newName, string aiModelId, string systemPrompt, string summary)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The agent to change: `name`, or `name@namespace`. |
| `newName` | `string`, can be empty | The agent's name from now on. Pass its current name to keep it. |
| `aiModelId` | `string`, can be empty | The `id` of the catalogue model to run on, from [`AiModelList`](models.md#aimodellist). Pass `""` to keep the current model. |
| `systemPrompt` | `string`, can be empty | The agent's instructions from now on. Pass the current ones to keep them. |
| `summary` | `string`, can be empty | The agent's summary for other agents from now on. Pass the current one to keep it. |

**Returns** `jsonObject`: The agent, as a JSON object, as [`AgentGet`](#agentget) returns it.

The new version keeps the latest version's tools, routing, sub-interaction and web settings; when nothing changed, no version is added. Interactions keep using the agent version they were deployed with until you deploy them again.

Every argument but `aiModelId` is used as given, blank or not: to keep the name, instructions or summary, pass the current ones (read them with [`AgentGet`](#agentget)).

Name the agent as `name`, or `name@namespace` for one in another namespace of your tenant; a name without `@` is looked up in this app's namespace. Fails with `Not found` when there is no such agent, `Name cannot be empty.` for a blank new name, `Invalid AI model ID format: …`, and when the new name is taken or the model isn't in the catalogue.
